_comment: Connectors CI does not certify against a live sandbox, because there are no credentials for them in CI.
TODO: remove a connector from this list as soon as its credentials are added, so that it starts being certified.

d24.reason: No Directa24 sandbox credentials are configured in CI, so certification cannot run; WebPay Authorize, PSync, Refund and RSync were validated end to end against a local mock Directa24 server instead (HMAC signature, X-Login write/read-only key split, all 8 deposit statuses and all 6 refund statuses). Remove this entry once credentials are added so CI starts certifying it.

ecommpay.reason: Ecommpay staging credentials are not configured in CI, so certification cannot run. The sandbox forces a 3DS challenge on card payments that the harness cannot complete, so Capture, Void and Refund suites cannot reach a settled payment. Authorize, PSync, Capture, Void, Refund, RSync, SetupMandate, RepeatPayment and webhooks were exercised through Hyperswitch, UCS and the Ecommpay sandbox in the GRACE run; Apple Pay and Google Pay were not verified (no live wallet tokens). Remove this entry once credentials are added so CI starts certifying.

elavon_pg.reason: No Elavon Payment Gateway sandbox credentials exist for this integration yet; sandbox access has not been provisioned. The request the connector emits is proven against a local mock EPG server, driven end to end from Hyperswitch through UCS: card no-3DS settles, and the hosted-payment-page 3DS chain (CreateOrder, PaymentSession, shopper redirect) is exercised from HS with the settle proven at the UCS boundary. Live certification will follow once credentials are available.

etisalat.reason: Etisalat sandbox Authorize calls require a card-network roundtrip that exceeds the 30s connector_request_timeout from US-based CI runners; Capture and Void reach the gateway fine. Remove this entry once CI is run from a UAE-proximate host or the sandbox latency is resolved.

globalpayments_heartland.reason: Heartland Portico CERT credentials are not in the CI credentials file. All six declared suites were verified manually against the Portico CERT gateway (SOAP/XML PosGateway) during integration. Remove this entry once CI credentials are added.

globalpayments_realex.reason: GlobalpaymentsRealex sandbox credentials are not configured in CI; live sandbox verification for the six XML flows is attached to PR #2204. The 3DS2 legs past /protocol-versions cannot be exercised: the sandbox account is not entitled for 3D Secure.

ilixium.reason: Ilixium sandbox credentials are not configured in CI, so certification cannot run at all; it fails before any scenario executes. Remove this entry once credentials are added.

jpmorganorbital.reason: No JPMorgan Orbital sandbox credentials exist; validated against a local mock server only.

merchante.reason: No Merchante (MerchantE by Omise, cert.merchante-solutions.com) sandbox credentials are configured in CI yet — merchant onboarding is pending. Authorize (Sale/Preauth), Capture (Settle), Void, Refund, PSync/RSync (via retry_id Inquiry), SetupRecurring (Verify $0 with store_card=Y) and RepeatPayment (MIT with card_id + cit_mit_indicator=M101) were designed against the documented certification endpoint during development. Remove this entry once credentials are added so CI starts certifying it.

nexixpay.reason: No Nexi XPay sandbox API key is configured in CI, so certification cannot run. CI also cannot cover what the server-to-server API itself rules out: card payments are 3DS-only (3-step init, browser ACS, validation, payment), so the no-3DS global suites cannot chain; Nexi sends notifications only for Hosted Payment Page, Pay-by-Link and Build orders, so webhooks are checked against fixtures, not live delivery; and Nexi has no dispute API. Adding a sandbox key to CI, together with a 3DS-aware Authorize scenario that depends on PreAuthenticate, would close the card flows; the webhook and dispute gaps are properties of the Nexi API.

novalnet.reason: No Novalnet credentials are configured in the CI creds file, so certification cannot run. Card Authorize (automatic and manual capture, 3DS redirect), PayPal redirect, PSync, Capture, Void, Refund and RSync were verified manually against a Novalnet test account. Still uncovered: Google Pay and Apple Pay need real device tokens encrypted for the Novalnet merchant, and webhook source verification needs a configured webhook secret plus a harness signer for Novalnet's body checksum. Remove this entry once CI credentials are added.

paydotcom.reason: No Pay.com sandbox credentials are available; the integration is verified end to end from Hyperswitch through UCS against a mock Pay.com server, with request shapes checked against apiref.pay.com. See PR #2223.

payhere.reason: No PayHere sandbox credentials (App ID/App Secret/Merchant ID/Merchant Secret) are configured in CI, so certification cannot run. Remove this entry once credentials are added so CI starts certifying it.

paynearme.reason: No PayNearMe sandbox credentials exist; the integration was verified against a local spec-shaped mock server (outbound request + response parsing) rather than the live sandbox.

saferpay.reason: Saferpay sandbox credentials are not configured in CI; live sandbox verification is attached to PR #2183.

travelhub.reason: new connector; no CI credentials yet (username/password/merchant_id for Worldline preprod not provisioned, and the current test merchant returns INVALID on authorize); remove from this list once credentials are added so CI starts certifying it

worldpayraft.reason: Only temporary sandbox credentials are available for WorldpayRaft in CI; these credentials do not support all flows (e.g. refunds, captures, and void require a settled transaction that cannot be produced with the temporary access). Remove this entry once full sandbox credentials are provisioned so CI can certify all flows.
